description: Weekly price history for one dairy product, from the same USDA MARS weekly dairy reports behind get_dairy_price. Use for trends across report weeks; use get_dairy_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns up to `periods` most recent report rows, oldest first (default 30, max 365); geography defaults to US-Central and cheese defaults to geography 'Oceania'. Butter returns a withheld notice — USDA publishes only price differentials for butter, no US base price.

geography.description: Report region (US-Central, US-East, US-West; cheese uses US). Default: US-Central

periods.description: Number of most recent report rows to return (default 30, max 365)

product.description: Dairy product (cheese, butter, dry_whey, fluid_milk). Butter prices are withheld — see description

name: get_dairy_history
